d: Long, voluminous platinum white hair with a center part and wavy texture frames a face with an apparent age of early adulthood and a confident expression in sharp, amber-gold eyes. A muscular build is dressed in a deep purple and brown outfit consisting of a high-collared tunic and wide trousers, accented by gold trim and a teal patterned sash. Large, curving dark brown horns emerge from the head, accompanied by pointed, tufted ears and a small, white goatee. BODY COLOR: tan LEGS: digitigrade with brown cloven hooves
